title: Zen Garden in Ruins
description: A large rectangular wooden table holds an intricate miniature zen garden made of sand with concentric ripple patterns. Miniature objects including tiny cups, a rake, a ladder, and scattered debris are arranged across the sand while a string with hanging paper notes stretches above it. In the background are dusty shelves filled with jars and containers, with a large pile of sand and wood fragments to the left.
